# miniature-oid

> Free AI tool for miniature and wargaming collectors. Identify figures, sets, and paint schemes, and ask Reg for painting advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://miniature-oid.netlify.app/): Home — AI miniature/wargaming figure identifier ("The Tiny Curator"), Ask Reg painting-advice chat, and The Village (free hut page + optional Patreon membership from £4.95/month)

## About

Part of the FeelFamous ecosystem — free AI tools for specialists, collectors, and personal sellers.
Built by Chris P Taylor (Doc Strange). PLUR. World domination through kindness. One ember at a time.
